lessons.title: Use constrained optimization with SLSQP
lessons.summary: Optimize the objective function with equality constraints using the SLSQP method to ensure the sum constraint is met.
lessons.lesson: Use scipy.optimize.minimize with method='SLSQP' and include an equality constraint for the sum of h to be half the number of points.

lessons.title: Normalize the sum of h during optimization
lessons.summary: Ensure the sum of h remains constant during optimization by normalizing it after each update.
lessons.lesson: After each update to h, normalize it by scaling it to maintain the sum equal to half the number of points.

lessons.title: Compute cross-correlation for the objective function
lessons.summary: Use the cross-correlation between h and 1-h to compute the objective function value.
lessons.lesson: Define the objective function as the maximum value of the cross-correlation between h and 1-h, scaled by the dx value.
